source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 19 exercise solved (PDF 153-155): MCQ keys worked out from the chapter, model answers, numericals step by step, with Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Tick (√) the correct answer: (sahi jawab par nishan lagayein)

blocks.prompt:
19.1 What is the half-life of a radio nuclide if 1/16 of its mass is present after 2h?
(Agar 2 ghante baad radio nuclide ki mass ka 1/16 hissa baqi ho to us ki half-life kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1/16 = (1/2)⁴, yani 2 h = 120 min mein 4 half-lives guzri hain.
T½ = 120 min/4 = 30 min.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Shortcut: 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 — har qadam ek half-life. 1/16 tak 4 qadam, is liye 120 min ko 4 se taqseem karein.

blocks.prompt:
19.2 Gamma radiations are emitted due to:
(Gamma radiations kis wajah se kharij hoti hain?)

options.text: atoms ki de-excitation (oonchi energy se neeche aana)

blocks.explanation: α ya β decay ke baad nucleus aksar excited (oonchi energy wali) haalat mein reh jata hai; jab woh neeche wali energy haalat mein aata hai to faltu energy γ-ray photon ki shakal mein nikalti hai. Is liye γ-rays nuclei ki de-excitation se aati hain (atoms ki de-excitation se roshni ya X-rays aati hain).

blocks.prompt:
19.3 Cadmium rods are used in nuclear reactor for:
(Nuclear reactor mein cadmium rods kis kaam ke liye istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cadmium bohat se neutrons jazb (absorb) kar sakta hai. Cadmium (ya boron) ki control rods core mein andar bahar ki jati hain taake fission ke liye neutrons kam hon aur chain reaction control rahe. Neutrons ko ahista karna moderator ka kaam hai.

blocks.prompt:
19.4 The mass of fissionable material needed for self-sustaining chain reaction is called:
(Self-sustaining (khud chalne wali) chain reaction ke liye fissionable material ki zaroori mass ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Critical mass: uranium ki woh mass jis mein ek fission se nikalne wale neutrons mein se sirf ek neutron agla fission karta hai, yun chain reaction khud chalti rehti hai. Is se kam (sub-critical) mass mein reaction ruk jati hai; bohat zyada (supercritical) mass mein dhamaka hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
19.5 Graphite and heavy water are two common moderators used in a nuclear reactor. The function of the moderator is:
(Graphite aur heavy water nuclear reactor ke do aam moderators hain. Moderator ka kaam kya hai?)

options.text: neutrons ko ahista kar ke thermal energy tak lana
neutrons jazb kar ke chain reaction rokna
reactor mein nikalne wali energy control karna

blocks.explanation: Fission se nikalne wale neutrons bohat tez hote hain; ahista (thermal) neutrons U-235 mein fission aasani se karte hain. Moderator (paani, heavy water, graphite) takkaron se neutrons ki raftaar kam karta hai. Neutrons jazb karna control rods ka kaam hai aur thanda karna coolant ka.

blocks.prompt:
19.6 The mass of a nucleus is always:
(Nucleus ki mass hamesha:)

options.text: usi element ke baqi sab nuclei ki mass ke barabar
proton aur neutron ki masses ke majmooe ke barabar
apne ajza (protons aur neutrons) ki masses ke majmooe se kam

blocks.explanation: Nucleus ki mass hamesha us ke protons aur neutrons ki kul mass se kam hoti hai. Yeh kami mass defect hai: Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus (Eq. 19.1); yahi mass binding energy ban jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
19.7 Binding energy per nucleon is:
(Binding energy per nucleon:)

options.text: bhari nuclei ke liye sab se kam
darmiyani mass wali nuclei ke liye zyada

blocks.explanation: Binding energy per nucleon aur A ke graph par yeh qeemat bohat halki aur bohat bhari nuclei ke liye kam aur darmiyani nuclei (A taqreeban 50 se 80) ke liye sab se zyada (iron-56 par taqreeban 8.7 MeV) hai. Yeh nuclei sab se zyada stable (mustahkam) hain.

blocks.prompt:
19.8 What remains unchanged in a fusion event?
(Fusion ke amal mein kya cheez nahi badalti?)
blocks.explanation: Har nuclear reaction mein nucleons ki kul tadaad (mass number) aur charge number wohi rehte hain. Fusion mein kuch mass energy ban jati hai, is liye mass aur energy badalti hain, magar nucleons ki tadaad nahi: ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n mein dono taraf 5 nucleons.

blocks.prompt:
19.9 Radioactive tracers are also employed to follow the path that various chemicals or food constituents take in:
(Radioactive tracers se mukhtalif chemicals ya khuraak ke ajza (food constituents) ka raasta kis mein dekha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 19.6: tracers se paudon aur janwaron mein chemical reactions, paude ka khaad (fertilizer) lena aur insani jism mein cheezon ki harkat (hazma, khoon ka bahao) dekhi jati hai. Is liye yeh sab.

blocks.prompt:
19.9 The K.E. of the fission fragments is ultimately converted to:
(Fission fragments (toote hue tukron) ki K.E. aakhir mein kis energy mein badal jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tez fission fragments fuel ke doosre atoms se takrate hain aur un ki kinetic energy heat (hararat) mein badal jati hai. Yeh heat steam banati hai jo turbine chalati hai (section 19.3).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Yeh sawal dobara 19.9 number ke saath chhapa hai; asal mein yeh daswan MCQ (19.10) hai. Number waisa hi rakha gaya hai jaisa chhapa.

blocks.prompt:
19.1 Define binding energy and how is it calculated?
Binding energy ki tareef karein aur yeh kaise nikali jati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Binding energy (bandhan energy): nucleus ko us ke alag alag protons aur neutrons mein torne ke liye kiya gaya work (nucleus bante waqt yahi energy nikalti hai).
Ise mass defect se nikalte hain:
Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus
B.E = (Δm)c² (joule mein; eV ke liye 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J eV⁻¹ se taqseem karein). Misal: helium ki B.E ≈ 27 MeV.

blocks.prompt:
19.2 Comment on the statement. “In radioactive decay, if the probability of decay per unit time is doubled, its half-life will also be doubled.”
Is bayan par raye dein: “Radioactive decay mein agar fi unit waqt decay ka imkaan double ho jaye to half-life bhi double ho jayegi.”
blocks.explanation: Yeh bayan ghalat hai. Fi unit waqt decay ka imkaan (probability) decay constant λ hai, aur T½ = 0.693/λ, yani half-life λ ke ulat mutanasib (inversely proportional) hai. λ double ho to half-life aadhi ho jati hai, double nahi (sample jaldi decay hota hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho: λ bara = har second zyada atoms toot-te hain = sample jaldi aadha hota hai = half-life chhoti. Yani λ aur T½ ulte chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
19.3 After four half-lives, what percentage of a radioactive sample remains?
Chaar half-lives ke baad radioactive sample ka kitna feesad baqi rehta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Har half-life ke baad aadhe nuclei baqi rehte hain: N = (1/2)ⁿ N₀.
n = 4 ke liye: N = (1/2)⁴ N₀ = N₀/16 = 0.0625 N₀
Yani sample ka 6.25 % baqi rehta hai (93.75 % decay ho chuka).

blocks.prompt:
19.4 Why natural uranium is said to be low grade nuclear fuel? Describe briefly.
Qudrati uranium ko low grade (kam darje ka) nuclear fuel kyun kaha jata hai? Mukhtasar bataein.
blocks.explanation: Qudrati uranium mein sirf taqreeban 0.7 % uranium-235 hota hai, jo ahista neutrons se aasani se fission karta hai; baqi taqreeban sab uranium-238 hai jo ahista neutrons se fission nahi karta balke neutrons jazb kar leta hai (aur plutonium-239 ban jata hai). Is liye qudrati uranium mein chain reaction aasani se nahi chalti aur energy kam milti hai; reactor ke liye ise 2.4–3.0 % U-235 tak enrich (tez) kiya jata hai. Isi liye ise low grade (kam darje ka) fuel kehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
19.5 Give an application of a radioactive tracers in medicine.
Medicine mein radioactive tracers ka ek istemal bataein.
blocks.explanation: Radioactive iodine (I-131) se thyroid gland check ki jati hai. Mareez ko thori si miqdaar di jati hai; thyroid ise jazb karti hai aur radiation detector se napte hain ke kitni jazb hui. Beemar ya hyperactive gland aam gland se do guna se zyada jazb karti hai. (I-131 thyroid cancer ke ilaaj mein bhi istemal hota hai.)

blocks.prompt:
19.6 How is energy generated in the Sun? Describe briefly.
Sooraj mein energy kaise banti hai? Mukhtasar bataein.
blocks.explanation: Sooraj ki energy us ke markaz (core) mein nuclear fusion se banti hai. Wahan bohat zyada temperature (10 million °C se zyada) par hydrogen nuclei itni tezi se chalte hain ke apni electrostatic repulsion (dhakka) par qaboo pa kar jur jate hain aur helium bante hain (thermonuclear reaction). Fusion mein thori mass kam ho kar energy ban jati hai, E = (Δm)c²: har helium nucleus banne par taqreeban 27 MeV. (Sooraj mein chaar protons qadam ba qadam jur kar ek helium nucleus bante hain, proton–proton chain: chapter se aage.)

blocks.prompt:
19.7 What is meant by the half-life of a radioactive material?
Radioactive material ki half-life se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation: Radioactive material ki half-life (T½) woh waqt hai jis mein sample ki activity (ya undecayed nuclei ki tadaad) apni shuru wali qeemat se aadhi reh jaye. T½ = 0.693/λ. Har element ki apni half-life hai, maslan radon 3.8 din, radium-226 1620 saal, uranium-238 4.5 × 10⁹ saal.

blocks.prompt:
19.8 What is meant by controlled and uncontrolled fission chain reaction? Describe briefly.
Controlled aur uncontrolled fission chain reaction se kya muraad hai? Mukhtasar bataein.
blocks.explanation: Controlled chain reaction mein har fission ke neutrons mein se (ausatan) sirf ek neutron agla fission karta hai, is liye energy ek jaisi raftaar se nikalti hai (nuclear reactor). Uncontrolled chain reaction mein har fission se ek se zyada neutrons agle fission karte hain, fissions ki tadaad bohat tezi se barhti hai aur bara dhamaka hota hai (atom bomb).

rows: Har fission se ausatan ek neutron agla fission karta hai
Har fission se ek se zyada neutrons agle fission karte hain
Fission ki raftaar ek jaisi rehti hai
Fission ki raftaar bohat tezi se barhti hai
Uranium ki mass critical mass ke barabar
Uranium ki mass critical mass se bohat zyada
Faltu neutrons cadmium ya boron control rods jazb karti hain
Neutrons par koi control nahi
Energy ahista aur barabar; nuclear reactor mein istemal
Bohat kam waqt mein bohat energy; dhamaka (atom bomb)

blocks.prompt:
19.1 In what ways a nuclear power station is different to a fossil fuel burning power station called thermal power plant?
Nuclear power station fossil fuel jalane wale power station (thermal power plant) se kin baaton mein mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono heat se paani ko steam banate hain jo turbine aur generator chalati hai; farq heat banane ke tareeqe, fuel aur waste (fuzla) mein hai.

rows: Heat reactor core mein uranium-235 (ya plutonium-239) ke fission se
Heat furnace mein coal, tel ya gas jalane se
Har fission se taqreeban 200 MeV; thora fuel bohat energy
Har molecule jalne se chand eV; bohat zyada fuel chahiye
Ek dafa dala fuel kai mahine chalta hai
Fuel musalsal dena parta hai
Moderator, control rods, coolant aur heat exchanger chahiye
Furnace aur boiler chahiye
Dhuan ya carbon dioxide nahi; hawa saaf
Dhuan, CO₂ aur gases; hawa ki aloodgi aur global warming
Lambi half-life wala radioactive waste; mehfooz jagah (purani namak ki kaanon) mein rakhna parta hai
Raakh aur gases ka waste; radioactive nahi
Radiation ka khatra; shielding aur sakht hifazat chahiye
Radiation ka khatra nahi

blocks.prompt:
19.2 If fusion reactors are developed, what advantage are they likely to have over fission nuclear reactors?
Agar fusion reactors ban jayein to un ke fission reactors par kya faide honge?
blocks.explanation:
Fusion reactors ke fission reactors par mumkina faide:
1. Fi nucleon zyada energy: ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV, yani taqreeban 3.5 MeV fi nucleon, jabke uranium fission mein taqreeban 0.9 MeV fi nucleon.
2. Sasta aur wafir fuel: deuterium (bhari hydrogen) aam paani (samandar) mein mojood hai; uranium kam milta hai aur enrich karna parta hai (chapter se aage).
3. Saaf product: asal product helium radioactive nahi, is liye fission fragments ke muqable mein lambi umar wala radioactive waste bohat kam.
4. Zyada mehfooz: koi chain reaction nahi jo qaboo se bahar ho; halaat kharab hon to reaction khud ruk jati hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
19.3 The activity of a radioactive sample is found to decay by 10 percent in a year. What will be the activity after another year? Explain.
Radioactive sample ki activity ek saal mein 10 feesad kam hoti hai. Agle saal ke baad activity kitni hogi? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Radioactive decay exponential hai (A = A₀e^(−λt)): barabar waqt mein activity utne hi hisse (fraction) se kam hoti hai, utni hi miqdaar se nahi.
Pehle saal ke baad: A₁ = A₀ − 0.10A₀ = 0.90A₀
Agle saal ke baad: A₂ = 0.90A₁ = 0.90 × 0.90A₀ = 0.81A₀
Yani activity asal ka 81 % hogi. Doosre saal mein 0.90A₀ ka 10 % kam hota hai, yani asal ka 9 %, A₀ ka mazeed 10 % nahi (80 % nahi banti).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal se samjhein: 100 se 10 % kam = 90; 90 ka 10 % = 9, to 90 − 9 = 81. Har saal “baqi ka” 10 % ghatta hai, shuru wale ka nahi.

blocks.prompt:
19.4 A source has an activity of 10 x 10⁴ Bq and a half-life of 20 minutes. What will be the activity of the source after one hour?
Ek source ki activity 10 × 10⁴ Bq aur half-life 20 minute hai. Ek ghante baad us ki activity kitni hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: A₀ = 10 × 10⁴ Bq = 1.0 × 10⁵ Bq, T½ = 20 min, t = 1 h = 60 min
Half-lives ki tadaad: n = t/T½ = 60 min/20 min = 3
A = A₀(1/2)ⁿ = 1.0 × 10⁵ Bq × (1/2)³ = 1.0 × 10⁵/8
A = 1.25 × 10⁴ Bq
Ek ghante baad activity 1.25 × 10⁴ Bq hogi (shuru ka aathwan hissa).

blocks.prompt:
19.5 What factors make a fusion reaction difficult to achieve?
Fusion reaction haasil karna kin wajohat se mushkil hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Dono nuclei positive charge wale hain, is liye ek doosre ko zor se dhakka dete hain (Coulomb force). Unhein bohat qareeb lane ke liye is repulsion ke khilaf work karna parta hai, is liye fusion shuru karne ko bohat energy chahiye.
2. Nuclei ki raftaar bohat zyada honi chahiye: is ke liye taqreeban 10 million °C temperature chahiye (thermonuclear reaction). Aam taur par itna temperature mumkin nahi; ab tak fusion sirf hydrogen bomb mein hua hai jise atom bomb se chalaya jata hai.
3. Itne garam maadde (plasma) ko koi bartan nahi rok sakta; use taqatwar magnetic fields se kaafi der tak ghane (dense) haalat mein rokna parta hai (Tokamak, maslan China ka EAST).
4. Accelerator se chand nuclei jor sakte hain (research) magar bari miqdaar mein musalsal energy nahi milti. Is liye fusion abhi tak bijli banane ke liye control nahi hua.

blocks.prompt:
19.6 In what way a nuclear reaction is different from chemical reaction? Explain.
Nuclear reaction chemical reaction se kis tarah mukhtalif hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nuclear reaction atom ke nucleus ko badalti hai; chemical reaction sirf atoms ke bahar wale electrons (bonds) ki tarteeb badalti hai.

rows: Nucleus (protons aur neutrons) mein hoti hai
Sirf atoms ke bahar wale electrons shamil
Ek element doosre element mein badal jata hai (transmutation)
Elements wohi rehte hain; atoms sirf naye molecules mein jurte hain
Bohat energy, har reaction mein million eV (fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV)
Kam energy, har reaction mein chand eV
Napne ke qabil mass energy banti hai: E = (Δm)c²
Mass ki tabdeeli na hone ke barabar
Mass number aur charge number mehfooz (conserved)
Har element ke atoms ki tadaad mehfooz
Temperature, pressure ya chemical haalat ka asar nahi (maslan radioactive decay)
Raftaar temperature, pressure, concentration aur catalyst par munhasir
Ek element ke isotopes alag alag react karte hain
Ek element ke sab isotopes ek jaise react karte hain

blocks.prompt:
19.7 Suggest a reason why neutron are absorbed in the boron rods and the rods become hot as a result of this reaction.
Wajah bataein ke boron rods mein neutrons kyun jazb hote hain aur is reaction se rods garam kyun ho jati hain.
blocks.explanation: Boron (khaas taur par boron-10 isotope) neutrons, khaas kar ahista neutrons, ko pakarne (capture) ki bohat salahiyat rakhta hai, is liye boron rods (cadmium ki tarah) neutrons hata kar chain reaction control karti hain. Neutron pakarne wala boron-10 nucleus unstable ho kar toot jata hai: ¹⁰₅B + ¹₀n → ⁷₃Li + ⁴₂He + energy (taqreeban 2.8 MeV) (chapter se aage). Tez lithium nucleus aur α-particle rod ke atoms se takrate hain aur un ki kinetic energy heat ban jati hai, is liye rods garam ho jati hain aur unhein thanda karna parta hai.

blocks.prompt:
19.1 Define the terms mass defect and binding energy. What information is given by the graphical curve between binding energy per nucleon against nucleon number?
Mass defect aur binding energy ki tareef karein. Binding energy per nucleon aur nucleon number ke graph se kya maloomat milti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Mass defect: nucleus ki mass hamesha us ke protons aur neutrons ki kul mass se kam hoti hai. Yeh kam hone wali mass, mass defect hai:
Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus
Binding energy: nucleus ko us ke protons aur neutrons mein torne ke liye kiya gaya work. Kam hone wali mass yahi energy ban jati hai (Einstein ka mass-energy relation):
B.E = (Δm)c²
Misal: helium ke liye Δm = 0.048318 × 10⁻²⁷ kg aur B.E ≈ 27 MeV. Stability (mustahkami) ka behtar paimana binding energy per nucleon = B.E/A hai, yani ek nucleon nikalne ki ausat energy.
Binding energy per nucleon aur nucleon number A ka graph (Fig. 19.1):
1. Hydrogen (ek proton) ke liye zero; helium tak tezi se barhta hai (taqreeban 7 MeV), jo batata hai ke hydrogen se helium banne par bohat energy nikalti hai.
2. Iron-56 par sab se zyada, taqreeban 8.7 MeV; yeh sab se stable nuclide hai; A taqreeban 50 se 80 wale nuclei sab se stable.
3. Phir aahista aahista kam ho kar uranium ke liye taqreeban 7.6 MeV.
Graph se milne wali maloomat:
(i) Stability: binding energy per nucleon jitni zyada, nucleus utna stable; bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei kam stable.
(ii) Fission: bhari nucleus (U-235, 7.6 MeV) do darmiyane nuclei (Ba, Kr, taqreeban 8.5 MeV) mein toote to taqreeban 0.9 MeV fi nucleon, yani har fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV nikalti hai.
(iii) Fusion: do halke nuclei (maslan ²₁H aur ³₁H) jur kar bhari nucleus (A taqreeban 50 se kam) banayein to energy nikalti hai.
(iv) Aam qaida: jis nuclear reaction mein products ki binding energy per nucleon barhe, us se energy milti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Graph ko pahari samjhein: oopar chotti par iron-56 (sab se mazboot). Dono kinaron se (halke nuclei jur kar = fusion, bhari nuclei toot kar = fission) chotti ki taraf jane par energy nikalti hai. Exam mein graph ka khaka (sketch) zaroor banaein: A x-axis par, B.E/nucleon y-axis par.

blocks.prompt:
19.2 What is nuclear fission? Explain critical mass and nuclear fission chain reaction.
Nuclear fission kya hai? Critical mass aur nuclear fission chain reaction ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nuclear fission: woh reaction jis mein uranium jaisa bhari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot jata hai aur energy nikalti hai. Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann ne dekha ke ahista neutrons uranium-235 ko tor dete hain:
²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba + ⁹²₃₆Kr + 3¹₀n + Q
Har fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV nikalti hai. Wajah: uranium ki binding energy per nucleon taqreeban 7.6 MeV aur Ba, Kr ki taqreeban 8.5 MeV, is liye 0.9 MeV × 235 ≈ 211 MeV nikalti hai. Tukre alag bhi ho sakte hain (maslan Sn + Mo, Xe + Sr); sab radioactive hote hain. U-235 aur Pu-239 ahista neutrons se sab se aasani se fission karte hain.
Fission chain reaction: har fission se 2 ya 3 neutrons nikalte hain. Agar yeh neutrons mazeed uranium nuclei mein fission karein jo aur neutrons dein, to reaction khud chalti rehti hai. Ise fission chain reaction kehte hain. Agar control na ho to fissions ki tadaad bohat tezi se barhti hai aur bohat kam waqt mein bohat energy dhamake ke saath nikalti hai (atom bomb).
Critical mass: uranium ki patli sheet mein zyada tar neutrons bahar nikal jate hain aur chain reaction nahi hoti; kaafi bare tukre mein zyada tar neutrons nikalne se pehle jazb ho jate hain. Uranium ki woh mass jis mein ek fission ke sab neutrons mein se ek neutron agla fission kare, critical mass kehlati hai (us ka hajm critical volume).
1. Mass critical se kam: chain reaction ruk jati hai.
2. Mass critical ke barabar: reaction ek jaisi raftaar se chalti hai (controlled chain reaction, nuclear reactor).
3. Mass critical se bohat zyada: reaction tezi se barh kar dhamaka (atom bomb).
Reactor mein cadmium (ya boron) control rods faltu neutrons jazb karti hain taake har fission se sirf ek neutron agla fission kare.

blocks.prompt:
19.3 Describe a nuclear power reactor with its components and their functions.
Nuclear power reactor ko us ke hisson aur un ke kaam ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nuclear power station mein reactor wohi kaam karta hai jo thermal power station mein furnace: reactor mein fission heat banata hai, heat steam banati hai, steam turbine chalati hai aur turbine generator chalati hai.
Aham hisse aur un ke kaam:
1. Core aur fuel: fuel (2.4–3.0 % U-235 tak enrich kiya hua uranium; plutonium-239 ya uranium-233 bhi) core mein cylinder jaisi fuel rods mein rakha jata hai; yahan fission hota hai aur heat banti hai (har fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV; core ka temperature taqreeban 500 °C).
2. Moderator: fuel rods ke ird gird paani, heavy water ya graphite. Yeh tez fission neutrons ko ahista karta hai, kyunke ahista neutrons U-235 aur Pu-239 mein fission zyada aasani se karte hain.
3. Control rods: cadmium ya boron ki rods jo neutrons jazb karti hain. Inhein core mein andar bahar kiya jata hai taake har fission se sirf ek neutron agla fission kare aur chain reaction ek jaisi rahe. Emergency ya marammat ke waqt yeh poori andar gir kar reactor band kar deti hain.
4. Coolant aur heat exchanger: paani, heavy water ya koi aur maya (liquid) zyada pressure par core ki heat heat exchanger tak le jata hai, jahan aam paani garam steam banta hai (pressurizer coolant ka pressure qaim rakhta hai).
5. Turbine aur generator: steam turbine ghumati hai, turbine generator ghumati hai aur bijli banti hai.
6. Condenser: turbine se nikalne wali steam (taqreeban 300 °C) darya ya samandar ke paani se thandi kar ke dobara paani banai jati hai aur wapas pump hoti hai.
KANUPP mein heavy water moderator aur coolant tha aur steam samandar ke paani se thandi hoti thi. Istemal shuda fuel bohat radioactive hota hai aur mehfooz jagah (maslan gehri, khushk purani namak ki kaanon) mein rakha jata hai. Reactor ke gird mota concrete shield radiation rokta hai (chapter ke text se aage).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: Fuel (heat banata hai) → Moderator (neutron ahista) → Control rods (neutron ginti) → Coolant (heat le jata hai) → Steam → Turbine → Generator. Exam mein reactor ka saada khaka bana kar hisson ke naam zaroor likhein.

blocks.prompt:
19.4 Describe why the very lighter nuclei and very heavy nuclei are unstable. How are they useful as a source of huge amount of energy?
Bataein ke bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei unstable kyun hain. Yeh bohat zyada energy ka zariya kaise hain?
blocks.explanation:
Bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei unstable kyun: binding energy per nucleon aur A ke graph par bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei ki qeemat kam aur darmiyane nuclei (A taqreeban 50–80) ki sab se zyada (taqreeban 8.7 MeV) hai. Kam binding energy per nucleon ka matlab nucleons kam mazbooti se bandhe hain, is liye yeh nuclei kam stable hain.
(i) Bohat halke nuclei mein nucleons kam hain, is liye har nucleon ko sirf chand parosi pakarte hain (chapter se aage: zyada nucleons surface par hote hain).
(ii) Bohat bhari nuclei mein protons bohat zyada hain; un ki electrostatic repulsion poore nucleus mein kaam karti hai jabke nuclear force sirf qareebi parosiyon mein, is liye binding per nucleon kam ho jati hai (chapter se aage).
Energy ka zariya: jis nuclear reaction mein products ki binding energy per nucleon barhe, us mein energy nikalti hai; yeh energy kam hone wali mass se aati hai, E = (Δm)c².
1. Bhari nuclei ka fission: ²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba + ⁹²₃₆Kr + 3¹₀n + Q. Binding energy per nucleon 7.6 se 8.5 MeV ho jati hai, is liye har fission mein taqreeban 0.9 × 235 ≈ 200 MeV. Nuclear reactors (aur atom bomb) mein istemal.
2. Halke nuclei ka fusion: ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV. Fi nucleon fission se zyada energy. Is ke liye taqreeban 10 million °C chahiye; Sooraj aur sitaron (aur hydrogen bomb) ki energy isi se.

blocks.prompt:
19.5 What are radioactive tracers? Give some applications in medical diagnostics and treatment.
Radioactive tracers kya hain? Medical diagnostics aur ilaaj mein in ke kuch istemal bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Radioactive tracers: radioactive isotope jism mein bilkul usi element ke stable isotope ki tarah kaam karta hai, magar us ki radiation detect kar ke us ki jagah aur miqdaar aasani se maloom hoti hai. Stable element mein mila hua thora sa radioactive isotope tracer (nishan dahi karne wala) ban kar kisi chemical ya biological amal ko radiation detector se follow karne deta hai.
Medical diagnostics (beemari ki tashkhees):
1. Radio-iodine (I-131) thyroid gland jazb karti hai; jazb hone wali miqdaar se pata chalta hai ke thyroid theek kaam kar rahi hai ya nahi (beemar ya hyperactive gland do guna se zyada jazb karti hai).
2. Sodium-24 se khoon ki gardish (plasma volume) dekhi jati hai.
3. Phosphorus haddiyon mein aur cobalt liver mein jama hota hai, is liye yeh in aazaa ko trace karte hain; tracers hazme ka amal aur jism mein cheezon ki harkat bhi dikhate hain.
4. Table 19.1: Fe-59 plasma mein iron ke liye, technetium-99m (6 ghante) thyroid uptake scans, I-131 kidney tests, I-125 plasma volume aur vein flow ke liye.
5. Imaging devices (maslan PET scanning) mein tracers beemar tissue ki jagah batate hain.
Ilaaj (treatment):
1. I-131 ki bari miqdaar thyroid gland ke cancer ke khilaf.
2. Cancer cells tezi se barhte hain, zyada radiation jazb karte hain aur aam cells se aasani se khatam hote hain.
3. Capsules (‘seeds’) mein radioisotopes malignant (cancer wale) tissue mein rakh kar maqami ilaaj.
4. Skin cancer ke liye phosphorus-32 ya strontium-90.
Dose bohat ehtiyat se control karni parti hai kyunke radiation sehatmand tissue ko bhi nuqsaan deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
19.6 What is half-life? Derive the relation between number of half-lives and time. How we can, calculate the remaining and decayed quantity after several half-lives?
Half-life kya hai? Half-lives ki tadaad aur waqt ka taluq derive karein. Kai half-lives ke baad baqi aur decay shuda miqdaar kaise nikalte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Half-life (T½): woh waqt jis mein radioactive sample ki activity ya undecayed nuclei ki tadaad shuru wali qeemat se aadhi reh jaye.
Half-lives ki tadaad aur waqt ka taluq:
Agar shuru mein N₀ nuclei hon,
1 half-life ke baad: N = N₀/2 = (1/2)¹N₀
2 half-lives ke baad: N = (1/2)(N₀/2) = (1/2)²N₀
3 half-lives ke baad: N = (1/2)³N₀
n half-lives ke baad: N = (1/2)ⁿ N₀
Agar guzra hua waqt t ho to half-lives ki tadaad n = t/T½, is liye
N = N₀(1/2)^(t/T½)
Yahi natija decay law N = N₀e^(−λt) se: t = T½ par N = N₀/2 rakhein to e^(λT½) = 2, λT½ = ln 2 = 0.693, yani T½ = 0.693/λ.
n half-lives ke baad baqi miqdaar: N = N₀/2ⁿ
n half-lives ke baad decay shuda miqdaar: N₀ − N₀/2ⁿ = N₀(1 − 1/2ⁿ)
pehli ke baad N₀/2, doosri ke baad 3N₀/4, teesri ke baad 7N₀/8.
Yahi formulas mass ya activity ke liye bhi. Misal: polonium ke 1000 atoms (T½ = 140 din), 280 din mein: n = 2, baqi 1000/4 = 250, decay shuda 750.
Har half-life ke baad aadha baqi rehta hai, is liye radioactive sample kabhi poora decay nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
19.1 Find the mass defect and binding energy of the deuterium. The mass of deuteron is 3.3435 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.
(mass of proton mₚ = 1.6726 × 10⁻²⁷, mass of neutron mₙ = 1.6749 × 10⁻²⁷) (Ans: 2.23 MeV)
Deuterium ka mass defect aur binding energy maloom karein. Deuteron ki mass 3.3435 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: m_d = 3.3435 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, mₚ = 1.6726 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, mₙ = 1.6749 × 10⁻²⁷ kg (deuteron: Z = 1, A = 2)
Maloom karna: Δm aur B.E
Mass defect:
Δm = (mₚ + mₙ) − m_d
Δm = (1.6726 + 1.6749) × 10⁻²⁷ kg − 3.3435 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
Δm = 3.3475 × 10⁻²⁷ kg − 3.3435 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
Δm = 0.0040 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 4.0 × 10⁻³⁰ kg
Binding energy:
B.E = (Δm)c² = (4.0 × 10⁻³⁰ kg)(3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)²
B.E = 3.6 × 10⁻¹³ J
B.E = 3.6 × 10⁻¹³ J/1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J eV⁻¹ = 2.25 × 10⁶ eV
Jawab: Δm = 4.0 × 10⁻³⁰ kg, B.E ≈ 2.25 MeV (≈ 2.2 MeV). Kitab ka 2.23 MeV zyada durust masses se aata hai; chaar decimal wali di gayi masses se 2.25 MeV banta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne mₚ aur mₙ ke saath unit nahi likhi; dono kg mein hain (deuteron ki mass ki tarah). Pehle mass defect kg mein, phir c² se zarb de kar joule, aur 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ se taqseem kar ke eV.

blocks.prompt:
19.2 The decay constant of strontium is 1.99 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹. Find its half-life. (Ans: 9.7 hours)
Strontium ka decay constant 1.99 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹ hai. Us ki half-life maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: λ = 1.99 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹
Maloom karna: T½
T½ = 0.693/λ
T½ = 0.693/1.99 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹
T½ = 3.48 × 10⁴ s
Ghanton mein: T½ = 3.48 × 10⁴ s/3600 s h⁻¹ = 9.67 h
Jawab: T½ ≈ 9.7 ghante (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
19.3 Half-life of krypton is 3.16 minutes. Out of 40 g of krypton, how much will be left after 12.64 minutes? (Ans: 2.5 g)
Krypton ki half-life 3.16 minute hai. 40 g krypton mein se 12.64 minute baad kitna baqi rahega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: T½ = 3.16 min, N₀ = 40 g, t = 12.64 min
Maloom karna: baqi mass N
Half-lives ki tadaad: n = t/T½ = 12.64 min/3.16 min = 4
N = N₀(1/2)ⁿ
N = 40 g × (1/2)⁴ = 40 g/16
N = 2.5 g
Jawab: 2.5 g krypton baqi rahega (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
19.4 32 g sample of a radioactive material remain after 18 years. What is its half-life? (Ans: 3 years)
Radioactive material ka 32 g sample 18 saal baad baqi rehta hai. Us ki half-life kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: baqi mass N = 32 g, t = 18 saal
Maloom karna: T½
Shuru ki mass N₀ kitab mein nahi chhapi, is liye sawal jaisa chhapa hai waise hal nahi hota (box dekhein). Tareeqa:
N = N₀(1/2)ⁿ, is liye 2ⁿ = N₀/N se half-lives ki tadaad n, aur T½ = t/n.
Kitab ka jawab (3 saal) matlab n = 18 saal/3 saal = 6 half-lives, yani N = N₀/2⁶ = N₀/64. Is ke liye shuru ka sample N₀ = 32 g × 64 = 2048 g (taqreeban 2 kg) hona chahiye:
2ⁿ = 2048 g/32 g = 64 = 2⁶, yani n = 6
T½ = t/n = 18 saal/6
T½ = 3 saal
Jawab: T½ = 3 saal, agar 18 saal baad sample ka 1/64 (2048 g mein se 32 g) baqi ho.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein sample ki shuru wali mass nahi chhapi, is liye chhapay hue sawal se half-life nahi nikal sakti. Kitab ka jawab 3 saal sirf tab sahi hai jab 18 saal (6 half-lives) baad sample ka 1/64 baqi ho, maslan 2048 g mein se 32 g. Sahi sawal kuch yun hona chahiye: “2048 g sample mein se 18 saal baad 32 g baqi rehta hai; half-life kya hai?”

blocks.prompt:
19.5 An alpha particle has an energy of 5.56 MeV when released from the radiam atom. Determine its velocity. (Ans: 1.68 × 10⁷ ms⁻¹)
Radium atom se nikalte waqt alpha particle ki energy 5.56 MeV hai. Us ki velocity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: K.E. = 5.56 MeV = 5.56 × 10⁶ × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 8.896 × 10⁻¹³ J
α-particle (⁴₂He nucleus) ki mass (kitab mein nahi di): m ≈ 4 u = 4 × 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 6.64 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
Maloom karna: v
K.E. = ½mv², is liye v = √(2K.E./m)
v = √(2 × 8.896 × 10⁻¹³ J/6.64 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)
v = √(2.68 × 10¹⁴ m² s⁻²)
v = 1.64 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹
Jawab: v ≈ 1.64 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ (kitab 1.68 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ likhti hai; box dekhein). v roshni ki raftaar ka sirf taqreeban 5 % hai, is liye ½mv² istemal ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 1.68 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ likhti hai. K.E. = 5.56 MeV = 8.896 × 10⁻¹³ J aur mα = 6.64 × 10⁻²⁷ kg se v = √(2K.E./m) = 1.64 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ banta hai. Kitab wala jawab tab aata jab mass taqreeban 6.3 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hoti. “radiam” ghalat chhapa hai; sahi lafz radium hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: MeV ko joule mein badalna: 1 MeV = 10⁶ eV aur 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J. α-particle helium ka nucleus hai: 2 protons + 2 neutrons, mass taqreeban 4 u.

blocks.prompt:
19.6 Find the energy released during the nuclear reaction: ⁷₃Li + ¹₁H → 2⁴₂He
Mass of ⁴₂He = 4.00388u, ¹₁H = 1.00814 u and of ⁷₃Li = 7.01823u. (Ans: 19.2 MeV)
Is nuclear reaction mein nikalne wali energy maloom karein: ⁷₃Li + ¹₁H → 2⁴₂He.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: ⁷₃Li + ¹₁H → 2⁴₂He; m(Li) = 7.01823 u, m(H) = 1.00814 u, m(He) = 4.00388 u; 1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
Maloom karna: nikalne wali energy Q
Pehle mass: 7.01823 u + 1.00814 u = 8.02637 u
Baad mein mass: 2 × 4.00388 u = 8.00776 u
Δm = 8.02637 u − 8.00776 u = 0.01861 u
Δm = 0.01861 × 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 3.09 × 10⁻²⁹ kg
Q = (Δm)c² = (3.09 × 10⁻²⁹ kg)(3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 2.78 × 10⁻¹² J
Q = 2.78 × 10⁻¹² J/1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J eV⁻¹ = 1.74 × 10⁷ eV
Jawab: Q ≈ 17.4 MeV (1 u = 931.5 MeV lein to 0.01861 × 931.5 = 17.3 MeV). Kitab 19.2 MeV likhti hai; box dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 19.2 MeV likhti hai. Di gayi masses se Δm = 8.02637 u − 8.00776 u = 0.01861 u, jo 17.3–17.4 MeV banta hai. 19.2 MeV ke liye mass defect taqreeban 0.0206 u hona chahiye tha.

items: Numerical 19.4 mein shuru ki mass nahi chhapi; kitab ka jawab 3 saal tab sahi hai jab 1/64 hissa baqi ho (2048 g mein se 32 g).
Numerical 19.5: sahi jawab 1.64 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ (kitab 1.68 × 10⁷). Numerical 19.6: sahi jawab taqreeban 17.3 MeV (kitab 19.2 MeV).
Numerical 19.1 (2.25 MeV, kitab 2.23 MeV, sirf masses ke round hone ka farq), 19.2 aur 19.3 kitab se milte hain; baqi sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
